items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Melvin Berry on trombone, Charlie Fishbrunner myself.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, Mel Berry was playing in the Palisade at this time, see, when, you know, yeah. Mel, let's see, we had a combination, let's see, we had Joe Martinez on piano, rather, Charlie, this was his band. Joe Martinez on piano. We had Frank Portune on clarinet. He went out to California too. Melvin Berry on trombone, Charlie Fishbrunner myself. No corner, foul and fiddling. Oh, talking about Dave Perkins. You knew Dave Perkins? Oh, no, you didn't meet Dave.
Oh, Dave was dead. No, he was dead. He died a few years ago.

items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Mel Berry played with Charlie and I when... the Dixieland band.

ctx.x: And Melvin Berry, that was another one that I hear people talk about.
Well, Mel Berry played with, Mel Berry played with Charlie and I when, I bet, Carlton, just at the time, I'm telling you that the Dixieland band.
